criteria.text: States that the lock-up expires on 1 May 2027 (365 days after the 1 May 2026 Prospectus date).
Identifies that the comfort letter cut-off of 22 April 2026 is 9 days before the 1 May 2026 pricing date, outside the 3-business-day requirement in Clause 7(b), so a bring-down letter is needed.
Identifies the undisclosed $6,250,000 interest-free loan to director Marcus Thackeray that must be described in the Prospectus Related Party Transactions section.
Gives the lock-up as a duration (365 days) and a date (1 May 2027), with days remaining from 13 April 2026 (383 days).
Notes that 1 May 2027 is a Saturday and identifies the next Business Day, 3 May 2027, as the first trading opportunity.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
